title: galium palustre subsp. constrictum
intro: Galium palustre subsp. constrictum, commonly known as a subspecies of marsh bedstraw, is a perennial herb that belongs to the Rubiaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help alleviate symptoms of digestive issues and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Galium palustre subsp. constrictum include its ability to act as an anti-diarrheal, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant, making it a potential remedy for conditions like diarrhea, bronchitis, and asthma. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential therapeutic benefits.
